name: curator-workspace
comment: Workspace root for the JavaScript side (web/ and packages/schema/ts). There is no root application — this file exists to carry the pnpm settings below. Rationale in docs/build-log.md; verify with `pnpm --filter @curator/web audit:deps`.
comment_overrides: Every entry is a transitive dependency that resolved to a release newer than the 180-day supply-chain policy. Each pinned version still satisfies its parent's declared range (checked against the registry), so nothing is being forced past a real constraint. @tanstack/query-core and abitype are peer dependencies that autoInstallPeers resolved to latest; they are pinned to the exact versions their parents (@tanstack/react-query, viem) already depend on.
